item.cyberblock.quickhack.usage: Hold [%1$s] on a target, then right-click (or hold [%1$s], wheel to pick, right-click)
hack.cyberblock.device: Device hack: cameras, traffic lights, vending machines
cyberblock.binds.note: Cyberpunk cannot forward %1$s for %2$s, so there it works as %3$s (allowed: G K L O U Y 0 F1-F4 F6-F8 F10-F12)

cyberblock.binds.clash: Two Cyberblock keys would be the same key in Cyberpunk, so there all four work as %s %s %s %s
cyberblock.hack.no_target: Hold %s and look at a target

cyberblock.hack.need_device: The Redstone Lever only works on devices
cyberblock.hack.need_npc: This quickhack needs a person or an occupied car
cyberblock.ram.label: RAM %s/%s
cyberblock.skills.title: Skill Tree
